fields.summary_ko.0: ANT conducted an IPO on November 18 at $83/share, raising $81.3B in the largest IPO on record, surpassing SpaceX's $75B
fields.summary_ko.1: SPCX raised $75B in an IPO on June 12, 2026 at $135/share and rose 19% on the first trading day, achieving a market cap of approximately KRW 2.1 trillion
fields.summary_ko.2: Among the top 10 IPOs of all time, Visa has delivered a 2,854% return from its 2008 IPO price of $11 to present, while Meta declined 47% initially before returning +1,572% from its 2012 IPO price
